comment: S5 rapid re-click — duplicate run_analysis mid-flight with a FRESH client turn_id (concurrent_duplicate: runner fires the duplicate ~400ms after the primary; neither aborts the run on non-2xx, the duplicate's status IS the measurement). D10-api asserts a single fact-commit set via L0 diff — on the frozen graph a true double execution is payload-sha identical (deterministic analysis), so a double commit is unambiguous. CEE #430 (client-abort log reclassification) landed at this branch's base: the dim MEASURES current behaviour, it does not assume pre-#430 behaviour. Run with --l0 or D10 is honestly UNMEASURABLE.
